title: Detention time alerts for dispatchers
body:
As a dispatcher, I want to be alerted when a truck has been waiting at a shipper or receiver for more than 2 hours, so I can escalate and bill detention charges on time.

**Acceptance criteria**

* Detect arrival and departure at a facility using geofences around pickup and delivery addresses
* Send an alert to the assigned dispatcher at 2 hours of dwell time, then every hour after that
* Automatically add a detention line item to the load (rate set per customer contract)
* Weekly report of top facilities by average dwell time

**Requested by:** Joe Smith, after drivers raised unpaid wait time as their top complaint in the Q3 carrier survey.
author: Abraham AIProject
